Ownership and existence carry forward across pages; interval transfer counts reset after each checkpoint. Submit JSON rows in checkpoint order after the terminal page.

Ownership and existence carry forward across pages; interval transfer counts reset after each checkpoint. Submit JSON rows in checkpoint order after the terminal page.

Destroyed, closed, voided, or left-ledger objects are not live and count for nobody unless a later page creates/opens them again. Ownership and existence carry forward across pages; interval transfer counts reset after each checkpoint. Submit JSON rows in checkpoint order after the terminal page.
